questions_asked: Compare and contrast the efficiency of real-time accident detection in video streams when implementing YOLOv8 versus a traditional computer vision-based approach using object detection algorithms like Haar cascades. Justify your comparison with examples from real-world applications, and consider the trade-offs in terms of computational resources and accuracy.
